# The Aviator Training School (TATS)

> Evidence-first aviation training institute based in Trivandrum, Kerala, India. Founded November 2023. Offers EASA CPL(A) and ATPL pathways delivered in partnership with Goldwings Flight Academy, Poland, plus a PPL pathway in Serbia (AC 48) for working professionals.

TATS trains cadets from zero aviation experience through to an EASA Commercial Pilot Licence with Multi-Engine Instrument Rating and a Frozen ATPL. Ground school and ATPL theory are delivered in Trivandrum; flight training takes place at Goldwings Flight Academy in Poland. TATS publishes verified DGCA exam results for every attempt.

## Programmes

- [TATS 120](https://preview.theaviatortraining.com/programs/tats-120): 23-month flagship pathway for students with no prior aviation experience — EASA CPL(A) + Multi-Engine IR, Frozen ATPL (14 subjects), MCC Certificate, JOC on a fixed-base Airbus A320 simulator.
- [TATS 120 ATPL Integrated](https://preview.theaviatortraining.com/programs/atpl-integrated): 23-month pathway completing all 960 hours of EASA ATPL theory in India before departing for Poland.
- [Fly Direct](https://preview.theaviatortraining.com/programs/fly-direct): 15-month Integrated ATPL pathway for candidates who have already cleared Meteorology, Navigation and Regulation.
- [TAPP 50](https://preview.theaviatortraining.com/programs/tapp-50): Flight Instructor Rating pathway for existing CPL holders, including airline interview preparation.
- [AC 48](https://preview.theaviatortraining.com/programs/ac-48): A 3-month Private Pilot Licence (PPL) pathway in Serbia for working professionals, including those based in the Middle East.
